carveScreenUnits.label: Carve screen units
carveScreenUnits.description: What units would you prefer to see on the carve screen? Config will always be metric since all common CNC firmware requires metric values as input.

reconnectAutomatically.label: Reconnect automatically
reconnectAutomatically.description: Automatically reconnect to the last machine you used when you open gSender.

firmwareFallback.label: Firmware fallback
firmwareFallback.description: The firmware gSender will resort to using if automatic detection fails.

baudRate.label: Baud rate
baudRate.description: Needs to match up with the value your CNC uses. (Serial transmission speed, Default 115200)

safeHeight.label: Safe height
safeHeight.description: Amount Z-axis will move up before moving in X/Y/A using go tos. (Doesn't apply to files, corner-movements, or parking, if homing is enabled this value becomes an offset from the top of the Z-axis, Default 0)

checkFileOnLoad.label: Check file on load
checkFileOnLoad.description: Runs Check Mode ($C) anytime a new g-code file is loaded.

outlineStyle.label: Outline style
outlineStyle.description: Choose how your files will be outlined. (Detailed takes longer and follows more closely, Square traces a simple bounding box, Rapidless Square does the same but ignores rapid/G0 moves, Default Detailed)

outlineSpeed.label: Outline speed
outlineSpeed.description: Set the feed rate used when outlining. (Lower values provide more controlled movements, Default 0 runs outline at maximum/G0 speed)

revertWorkspace.label: Revert workspace
revertWorkspace.description: Allow g-code 'job finishing' commands like M2 and M30 to reset your CNCs workspace back to G54 at the end of each job.

promptOnExit.label: Prompt on exit
promptOnExit.description: Pop up a confirmation window when exiting the program.

allowGcamToSendFiles.label: Allow gCAM to send files
allowGcamToSendFiles.description: Let gCAM running on this computer load programs directly into gSender with "Send to gSender". Files are refused while a job is running.

runSettingsBackup.label: Run settings backup
runSettingsBackup.description: Choose how often gSender will backup your settings. Useful in case you need to revert them in the future.

settingsBackupLocation.label: Settings backup location
settingsBackupLocation.description: Choose the location to backup your settings to. Default: your OS's appData location.

importedPluginsLocation.label: Imported plugins location
importedPluginsLocation.description: Choose the location to import your plugins to. Default: your OS's userData location.
importedPluginsLocation.restart: Restart gSender to load plugins from the new location.
importedPluginsLocation.restartAbandoned: Restart gSender to load plugins from the new location. Plugins in "{{previousUserPluginsDir}}" will no longer be scanned until you set this back.
importedPluginsLocation.updateFailed: Failed to update the plugins location. Please try again.

collectUsageData.label: Collect usage data
collectUsageData.description: This info is collected anonymously to help us improve gSender by seeing how people use it.

darkMode.label: Dark mode
darkMode.description: Change the app colours for reduced eye strain, better contrast, or just for fun!

usePendantViewAsDefault.label: Use pendant view as default UI
usePendantViewAsDefault.description: Launch directly into the touch-friendly pendant interface in fullscreen kiosk mode instead of the standard desktop UI. Requires an app restart to take effect.
usePendantViewAsDefault.restartToPendant: gSender needs to restart to switch to the pendant view.
usePendantViewAsDefault.restartToDesktop: gSender needs to restart to switch back to the desktop view.

droZeros.label: DRO zeros
droZeros.description: Set the number of decimal places shown between 1-4. (Default 0 shows 2 for mm and 3 for inches)

visualizerTheme.label: Visualizer theme
visualizerTheme.description: Independent colour control for the visualizer.

cameraProjection.label: Camera projection
cameraProjection.description: Perspective (default) shows depth like a normal camera view. Orthographic removes that depth distortion, keeping parallel lines parallel — useful for lining up toolpaths precisely.

showBoundingBox.label: Show bounding box
showBoundingBox.description: Draw a wireframe around the extents of the loaded G-code file.

showBoundingBoxLabels.label: Show bounding box labels
showBoundingBoxLabels.description: Show X/Y/Z dimension labels on the bounding box.

showMachineBedIndicator.label: Show machine bed indicator
showMachineBedIndicator.description: Draw an outline of the machine's homed work area once homing is complete.

trimGridToMachineBed.label: Trim grid to machine bed
trimGridToMachineBed.description: When the machine bed indicator is shown, clip the background grid to just past the bed's edges instead of a fixed square.

hideProcessedLines.label: Hide processed lines
hideProcessedLines.description: Hide processed g-code lines in the visualizer.

showPlannedLines.label: Show planned lines
showPlannedLines.description: While a job runs, highlight the toolpath between the bit and the last line sent to the controller.

animatePlannedLines.label: Animate planned lines
animatePlannedLines.description: A pulse runs along the planned lines in the order they will be cut.

lightweightOptions.label: Lightweight options
lightweightOptions.description: Enable with the feather when big files are slowing down your computer. (Light turns off 3D file view, Everything disables the visualizer)

followToolDuringRuntime.label: Follow tool during runtime
followToolDuringRuntime.description: While a job is running, pan the camera to track the tool in X/Y, keeping the same viewing angle and height.

portraitMacroBar.label: Portrait macro bar
portraitMacroBar.description: Show a quick-access macro bar at the bottom of the screen in portrait mode.

normal.label: Normal
normal.description: Set the movement distances and speeds used for each jogging preset.

continuousJogDelay.label: Continuous jog delay
continuousJogDelay.description: Where regular presses or clicks make single movements, hold for this long to begin jogging continuously. Some might prefer a longer delay like 700. (Default 250)

warnIfBadFile.label: Warn if bad file
warnIfBadFile.description: Warns if any invalid commands are found when a file is opened.

warnOnBadLine.label: Warn on bad line
warnOnBadLine.description: Warns if any invalid commands are found when running a job.

warnWhenSettingZero.label: Warn when setting zero
warnWhenSettingZero.description: Useful if you tend to set zero accidentally.

warnIfBeyondSoftLimits.label: Warn if beyond soft limits
warnIfBeyondSoftLimits.description: Warns if your file exceeds your machine limits based on the current zero point. (Homing and soft limits must be enabled)

jobEndNotifications.label: Job end notifications
jobEndNotifications.description: Show a carving summary at the end of each job.

maintenanceNotifications.label: Maintenance notifications
maintenanceNotifications.description: Show upcoming maintenance tasks at the end of each job.

popUpNotificationDuration.label: Pop-up notification duration
popUpNotificationDuration.description: How long notifications stay visible, in milliseconds, before auto-dismissing. (-1 keeps them up until manually dismissed, -2 disables them, Default 0 keeps default duration)

keyboard.label: Keyboard
keyboard.description: Control your CNC and navigate through gSender using custom key combinations on any keyboard, numpad, or macro pad.

gamepad.label: Gamepad
gamepad.description: Easily jog, set zeros, start jobs, and more using most common gamepads. Create your own profile or use a pre-made one.

squareUpCncRails.label: Square up CNC rails
squareUpCncRails.description: Misaligned rails can cause 90 degree cuts to come out skewed, the wizard will help fix this.

touchPlateType.label: Touch plate type
touchPlateType.description: Select the touch plate you're using with your machine. (Default Standard block)

showTouchPlateSwitcher.label: Show touch plate switcher
showTouchPlateSwitcher.description: Show a button on Probe tab to allow switching between touch plate types.

tipDiameter.label: Tip diameter
tipDiameter.description: Diameter of probe tip where it touches off the material. (Default 2)

blockThickness.label: Block thickness
blockThickness.description: Plate thickness where the bit touches when Z-axis probing using the Standard Block plate. (Default 15)

autozeroThickness.label: AutoZero thickness
autozeroThickness.description: Plate thickness where the bit touches when Z-axis probing using the AutoZero plate. (Default 5)

puckThickness.label: Puck thickness
puckThickness.description: Plate thickness where the bit touches when Z-axis probing when using the Z Probe plate. (Default 15)

zOffset.label: Z offset
zOffset.description: Adjust to improve the Z zeroing accuracy of your probe. (Default 0)

bitzeroThicknessXyz.label: BitZero thickness (XYZ)
bitzeroThicknessXyz.description: Plate thickness for XYZ probing where the bit touches the inset surface inside the bore. (Default 13)

bitzeroThicknessZOnly.label: BitZero thickness (Z-only)
bitzeroThicknessZOnly.description: Plate thickness for Z-only probing where the probe is placed flat on the surface. (Default 15.5)

xyThickness.label: XY thickness
xyThickness.description: Plate thickness where the bit touches when X/Y-axis probing. (Default 10)

xyRetract.label: XY retract
xyRetract.description: How much extra to move off the surface when probing. (Default 10)

zProbeDistance.label: Z probe distance
zProbeDistance.description: Movement in Z before it gives up on probing. (Reduce this value if you get a soft limit alarm 2 when probing, Default 30)

fastFind.label: Fast find
fastFind.description: Probe speed before the first touch-off. (Default 150)

slowFind.label: Slow find
slowFind.description: Speed for the more accurate second touch-off. (Default 75)

retraction.label: Retraction
retraction.description: How far the bit moves away after a successful touch. (Default 2)

probeMovementSpeed.label: Probe Movement Speed
probeMovementSpeed.description: Feed rate for retract/reposition moves during probing. If 0, these moves use rapid (G0). If set, they use a controlled feed move (G1) at this speed instead. (Default 0)

finalZRetract.label: Final Z retract
finalZRetract.description: How far to move away in the Z-axis at the end of the routine. (Default 2)

finalZRetract2.label: Final Z retract
finalZRetract2.description: How far to move away in the Z-axis at the end of the routine. (Default 1)

connectionTest.label: Connection test
connectionTest.description: Safety check to make sure your probe is connected correctly.

stopJoggingPastLimits.label: Stop jogging past limits
stopJoggingPastLimits.description: Prevent jogging in a direction where a limit switch has already been triggered.

parkLocation.label: Park location
parkLocation.description: The P on the main Carve page will always take you to this convenient parking spot. (Homing must be enabled)

spindleLaserControls.label: Spindle/laser controls
spindleLaserControls.description: Show the Spindle/Laser tab and related functions on the main Carve page.

insertDwellForSpindleCommands.label: Insert dwell for spindle commands
insertDwellForSpindleCommands.description: Adds a delay to give the spindle time to spin up.  This will insert a G4 command on every M3/M4 within the file, and is unnecessary if your firmware otherwise handles spindle-at-speed operations. (Default 0)

minimumSpindleSpeed.label: Minimum spindle speed
minimumSpindleSpeed.description: Match this to the minimum speed of your spindle. ($31, Default 10000)

maximumSpindleSpeed.label: Maximum spindle speed
maximumSpindleSpeed.description: Match this to the maximum speed of your spindle. ($30, Default 30000)

minimumLaserPower.label: Minimum laser power
minimumLaserPower.description: Match this to the minimum S word setting in your laser CAM software. ($731, Default 0)

maximumLaserPower.label: Maximum laser power
maximumLaserPower.description: Match this to the maximum S word setting in your laser CAM software. ($730, Default 255.000)

laserOnDuringOutline.label: Laser on during outline
laserOnDuringOutline.description: Turn on the laser at it's lowest power to see the job position better.

laserXOffset.label: Laser X offset
laserXOffset.description: X-axis offset from the spindle. (Mark with a v-bit then track the laser movement to reach that mark, $741, Default 0)

laserYOffset.label: Laser Y offset
laserYOffset.description: Y-axis offset from the spindle. (Mark with a v-bit then track the laser movement to reach that mark, $742, Default 0)

coolantControls.label: Coolant controls
coolantControls.description: Show the coolant tab and related functions on the main Carve page.

rotaryControls.label: Rotary controls
rotaryControls.description: Show the Rotary tab and related functions on the main Carve page.

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: Travel resolution in steps per degree. ($103, Default 19.75308642)

maxSpeed.label: Max speed
maxSpeed.description: Max axis speed, also used for G0 rapids. ($113, Default 8000)

forceSoftLimits.label: Force soft limits
forceSoftLimits.description: Enable soft limits when toggling into rotary mode. (grbl only)

forceHardLimits.label: Force hard limits
forceHardLimits.description: Enable hard limits when toggling into rotary mode. (grbl only)

visualizeNonCenterZeros.label: Visualize non-center zeros
visualizeNonCenterZeros.description: For any rotary files that aren't zeroed to the centerpoint, apply an offset when a cylinder diameter is found in the file.

useAAxisForGrbl.label: Use A-axis for grbl
useAAxisForGrbl.description: Enables A-axis controls and commands to be sent for devices running modified 4-axis grbl, rather than translating A into Y. (grbl only)

fileStart.label: File start
fileStart.description: Runs when you start a job, before the file itself runs.

filePause.label: File pause
filePause.description: If you'd like to stop accessories or move out of the way when you pause during a job.

fileResume.label: File resume
fileResume.description: Ensure that anything you set up for File pause is undone when you resume.

fileStopEnd.label: File stop/end
fileStopEnd.description: A catch-all to ensure that stopped or ended jobs always safely turn everything off.

passthrough.label: Passthrough
passthrough.description: Send tool change lines as-is, assuming your CNC can properly handle M6 and T commands.

gsenderStrategy.label: gSender strategy
gsenderStrategy.description:
Standard wizard will guide you through the steps to manually set up a new tool and resume cutting.

Flexible is similar but uses a touch plate like a tool length sensor.

Fixed is also guided but fully automated, moving around and measuring tools for you. Homing and TLS required.

Code is for fully custom setups.

skipDialog.label: Skip dialog
skipDialog.description: Won't prompt on Pause, and won't pause between Code blocks.

fixedSensorLocation.label: Fixed sensor location
fixedSensorLocation.description: The start location for probing. To not break bits, set it using a long tool with extra Z-axis space above the sensor. (Z should be negative)

firstToolBehaviour.label: First tool behaviour
firstToolBehaviour.description:
Control how the first tool change is handled. Many CAM programs add an initial tool change command even when you already have the tool loaded.

"Always run full wizard" runs the complete tool change process.

"Prompt for first tool" asks whether to run the full wizard or just probe the current tool length.

"Always probe length only" skips the tool change and only measures the current tool.

setToolChangeLocation.label: Set tool change location
setToolChangeLocation.description: Move the CNC to a more convenient location for manual tool changes instead of prompting to change over the sensor.

manualToolChangeLocation.label: Manual tool change location
manualToolChangeLocation.description: The location to move to when manually changing tools.

beforeToolChange.label: Before tool change
beforeToolChange.description: When using the Code strategy, this code is run as soon as an M6 command is encountered.

afterToolChange.label: After tool change
afterToolChange.description: When using the Code strategy, this code is run after a tool change is completed.

warnOnHome.label: Warn on home
warnOnHome.description: Warn when homing that the keepout area is disabled and collisions are possible depending on the homing cycle.

connectToIp.label: Connect to IP
connectToIp.description: IP address used to connect to CNCs over Ethernet and other network scanning. (Default 192.168.5.1)

ethernetPort.label: Ethernet port
ethernetPort.description: The port exposed by the controller for Ethernet connectivity. (Used when attempting to connect over Ethernet, Default 23)

machineStatus.label: Machine status
machineStatus.description: Automatically announce machine status changes using screen readers. (Idle, Running, Alarm, etc.)

progressIncrement.label: Progress increment
progressIncrement.description: The percentage increment at which to announce job progress. (Default 10%)

enableAudioCues.label: Enable audio cues
enableAudioCues.description: Play short sounds for specific machine events.

jobCompleteSound.label: Job complete sound
jobCompleteSound.description: Play sound when a job finishes.

alarmSound.label: Alarm sound
alarmSound.description: Play sound when the machine enters an alarm state.

toolChangeSound.label: Tool change sound
toolChangeSound.description: Play sound when a tool change is required.

probeSuccessSound.label: Probe success sound
probeSuccessSound.description: Play sound after a successful probe.

focusRings.label: Focus rings
focusRings.description: Show a high-contrast ring around the currently focused element for better keyboard navigation visibility.

focusTrapping.label: Focus trapping
focusTrapping.description: Keep keyboard focus within modals and dialogs when they are open.

reducedMotion.label: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Minimize animations and UI transitions for improved visibility and accessibility.

spindleSpeedInputType.label: Spindle speed input type
spindleSpeedInputType.description: Choose between a slider or a number input for adjusting spindle speed.

appDisplayScale.label: App display scale
appDisplayScale.description: Override the app's display scale independently of your OS' DPI settings.

keyboardControl.label: Keyboard control
keyboardControl.description: Allow orbiting, panning, and zooming of the 3D visualizer using arrow keys and hotkeys.

jobSummary.label: Job summary
jobSummary.description: Provide a text summary of the loaded g-code file for screen readers.

showSummaryVisually.label: Show summary visually
showSummaryVisually.description: Display the g-code summary text visually above the visualizer.

showKeyboardShortcutMap.label: Show keyboard shortcut map
showKeyboardShortcutMap.description: Show an overlay with active keyboard shortcuts.

row.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset this value to default?
row.resetPluginsDirIntro: Resetting this will stop gSender from scanning:
row.resetPluginsDirWarning: Plugins imported there will disappear from the Plugin Manager until you set this back. Are you sure you want to reset this value to default?

page.disconnectedMessage: Some settings may not appear unless connected to a machine.
page.emptySection: Check your search filter or connect to your machine to see more options.

preferences.importConfirm: All your current settings will be replaced. Are you sure you want to import your settings on gSender?
preferences.restoreConfirm: All your current settings will be removed. Are you sure you want to restore default settings on gSender?
preferences.importFailed: Failed to import settings. Please check the file format.

profileBar.importFailed: Failed to import settings. Please check the file format.

restoreDefaults.title: Restore Defaults
restoreDefaults.confirm: Are you sure you want to restore your <1>{{machineName}}</1> back to its default state?
restoreDefaults.tooltip: Make sure you click to apply your defaults to your controller
restoreDefaults.restored: Restored default settings for your machine.

flash.title: Flash Firmware
flash.intro: This feature exists to flash firmware onto a compatible SLB or Arduino-based device.
flash.warning: This process will disconnect your machine, and may take a couple of minutes to complete.
flash.noPort: No port specified - please connect to the device to determine what is being flashed.
flash.completed: Flash completed, please reconnect to your device.

wizards.atciRequiresGrblHal: ATCi is only supported by boards running grblHAL.
wizards.atciMinVersion: ATCi is only supported by grblHAL version {{version}} or above.
wizards.atciRestartMessage: Please manually restart your CNC controller (power cycle) and reconnect to gSender for these settings to take effect.

inputs.eventDialogDescription: Enter the G-code commands to run for this event.

0.details: Sets time length per step. Minimum 3usec.

1.details: Sets a short hold delay when stopping to let dynamics settle before disabling steppers. Value 255 keeps motors enabled with no delay.

2.details: Inverts the step signal. Set axis bit to invert (00000ZYX).

3.details: Inverts the direction signal. Set axis bit to invert (00000ZYX).

4.details: Inverts the stepper driver enable pin signal.

5.details: Inverts the all of the limit input pins.

6.details: Inverts the probe input pin signal.

10.details: Alters data included in status reports.

11.details: Sets how fast Grbl travels through consecutive motions. Lower value slows it down.

12.details: Sets the G2 and G3 arc tracing accuracy based on radial error. Beware: A very small value may effect performance.

13.details: Enables inch units when returning any position and rate value that is not a settings value.

20.details: Enables soft limits checks within machine travel and sets alarm when exceeded. Requires homing.

21.details: Enables hard limits. Immediately halts motion and throws an alarm when switch is triggered.

22.details: Enables homing cycle. Requires limit switches on all axes.

23.details: Homing searches for a switch in the positive direction. Set axis bit (00000ZYX) to search in negative direction.

24.details: Feed rate to slowly engage limit switch to determine its location accurately.

25.details: Seek rate to quickly find the limit switch before the slower locating phase.

26.details: Sets a short delay between phases of homing cycle to let a switch debounce.

27.details: Retract distance after triggering switch to disengage it. Homing will fail if switch isn't cleared.

30.details: Maximum spindle speed. Sets PWM to 100% duty cycle.

31.details: Minimum spindle speed. Sets PWM to 0.4% or lowest duty cycle.

32.details: Converts spindle commands into laser mode. Consecutive G1/2/3 commands will not halt when spindle speed is changed.

100.details: X-axis travel resolution in steps per millimeter.

101.details: Y-axis travel resolution in steps per millimeter.

102.details: Z-axis travel resolution in steps per millimeter.

110.details: X-axis maximum rate. Used as G0 rapid rate.

111.details: Y-axis maximum rate. Used as G0 rapid rate.

112.details: Z-axis maximum rate. Used as G0 rapid rate.

120.details: X-axis acceleration. Used for motion planning to not exceed motor torque and lose steps.

121.details: Y-axis acceleration. Used for motion planning to not exceed motor torque and lose steps.

122.details: Z-axis acceleration. Used for motion planning to not exceed motor torque and lose steps.

130.details: Maximum X-axis travel distance from homing switch. Determines valid machine space for soft-limits and homing search distances.

131.details: Maximum Y-axis travel distance from homing switch. Determines valid machine space for soft-limits and homing search distances.

132.details: Maximum Z-axis travel distance from homing switch. Determines valid machine space for soft-limits and homing search distances.

342.details: Used in mode 1 and 2 when $TPW command is issued and in mode 3.

343.details: Used in mode 1 and 2 when $TPW command is issued and in mode 3 to obtain an accurate tool offset.

344.details: Used in mode 1 and 2 when $TPW command is issued and in mode 3 to obtain an initial tool offset. If successful tool is backed off a bit and probing is redone with the slow feed rate from $343.

3x2.details: Interface gateway address. IPv4 or IPv6 address, up to 16 octets. May hold IPv4 address as either binary or text.

3x3.details: Interface netmask. IPv4 or IPv6 address, up to 16 octets. May hold IPv4 address as either binary or text.

3x4.details: Interface netmask. IPv4 or IPv6 address, up to 16 octets. May hold IPv4 address as either binary or text.

3x5.details: Port for serial communication, may be telnet protocol or a simple socket stream.

3x7.details: Port for two way communication, typically with web browser. Usually used for serial communication by grbl.
